change: Replace half-deficit with full-deficit in last-dose duration calculation. No timing, enable, thermal or range-lock changes.
user_report: More frequent dosing is better, but CO2 falls to47000/48000. User requests autonomous adjustment, upload and review for changing cylinder pressure.

telemetry.caveat: Observed net rise is not isolated valve calibration. Falling sensor readings can include redistribution between chambers as well as escape; the maintenance grid is not a physical leak fit.

pressure_review: Uses latest measured rise per previous valve duration; no manometer value or fixed regulator setting. Decreasing measured gain increases requested duration, bounded by10% before integer rounding; increasing gain reduces it immediately. Gradual depletion, notified/unannounced cylinder swap and loss of response remain modeled. Initial/no-response safety caps and1000ms mechanical maximum remain; no guarantee for arbitrary gas availability.
checks: Five C++ host regression suites passed
Both decreasing and increasing observed flow
Exact20s gate, rising/plateau/falling behavior, invalid reading, door and clock rollover
result: Earlier full-deficit-only and recent-rise-only results are retained as intermediate history. Current upload additionally learns the empirical zero-response opening floor to avoid repeatedly requesting ineffective5–8ms doses. No overall stability certification.

final_result: All five host suites pass, including20000 histories, startup-delay rejection, no false floor from modest duration reduction, higher-flow/overshoot floor invalidation, recent-rise trace replay and rollover. Threshold10ms hypothetical case last-hour49348..50032ppm vs46941..50188 without a floor; progressive flow reduction49383..50096ppm. Many stress scenarios fail and physical prolonged regulation has not been certified.

opening_offset.learning: Requires a useful dose observed in this boot/cylinder state. Only reductions to less than half the smallest proven useful duration may update the zero-response floor; modest reductions without an immediate response cannot invent long mechanical dead time. Successful duration at/below floor clears it. Any measured peak above51000 clears the floor so changed cylinder flow can reduce the duration below stale estimates.
opening_offset.limitation: Net response includes mixing, losses and possibly delayed previous gas; this is an empirical useful-opening floor, not a pure mechanical calibration. Pressure-independent last-dose gain is still bounded by initial/weak response caps and maximum1000ms.
opening_offset.startup_regression: 65ms and72ms with no response before any positive dose leave zero_ms=0; after80ms->5000ppm,1000ppm deficit requests16ms. Initial chamber-filling latency must not become a65ms opening floor.
pressure_regressions: 63ms successful,54ms without rise leaves floor0 rather than inventing54ms dead time
An overshooting response clears floor8 even if the applied duration13 is above it; next calculation can shrink below the old floor.
